title: Patch: Omura's Activate is not offered with no enemy Unit to aim at, so it cannot be spent on nothing and start its cooldown
notes: Issue #4833: Omura's Activate target is now required (R703, R3560008), so with no enemy Unit it is not offered and refused, and its cooldown cannot start on nothing. Script change only, no catalog change, claimed with --plays.

player.title: Omura's Activate is offered only with an enemy Unit to aim at
fixes: Omura's Activate can no longer be used with no enemy Unit on the field, where it did nothing and started its 3-turn cooldown.
